model: Gen 140 — sp3+SOC tight-binding parameters for halide perovskites (Pnma)
units: eV (energies and hopping integrals); n_harrison dimensionless
harrison_scaling: V(d) = V0 * (d0/d)^n_harrison, applied to Pb-I integrals
soc_fixed: deltaSO0 (Pb), deltaSO1 (I) fixed from Boyer-Richard 2016; not free in the fit
pbpb_fixed_zero: four Pb-Pb second-neighbor integrals constrained to 0
